name: biceps-curl-weight-plate-reverse
title: Biceps Curl: Weight Plate (Reverse)
primer: This exercise uses a free weight plate to build muscle.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, your knees slightly bent and your abs drawn in.
Grasp a plate in your hands with palms facing down, at the 11 o'clock and 1 o'clock positions.
Keeping your elbows and arms at your side, curl the plate slowly up towards your head.
Slowly return to the starting position.
